technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 3.5g, this KoColor LIPSTICK is expertly formulated with Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Microcrystalline Wax, Titanium Dioxide, Red 7 Lake, Iron Oxides. Delivering a high-fidelity Dusty Orchid color profile (`#B58A94`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
